title: H-ZKA: Reproducibility Package for Hierarchical Zero-Knowledge Cross-Chain Auditing
description: Reproducibility package for the H-ZKA manuscript: the protocol simulator and its experiment drivers, the Solidity contracts and transition tests, the Rust/Arkworks benchmarking harness, the tc/netem and Docker topology descriptions, and the raw per-seed CSV and JSON outputs behind every derived table. All cryptographic measurements are BN254 results at approximately 100-bit security under exTNFS.
